findings.summary: Acceptance 1 and 16 require `bun test` green, but the acceptance-16 test failed on a live re-run. The test 'a page the helper never announced itself on says it cannot be narrated here, once' timed out. Green is not reliably reproducible, so CI on the slower macOS, Windows and Linux runners can go red.
findings.evidence: Second full `bun test` run in the worktree exited 1: `error: Test "a page the helper never announced itself on says it cannot be narrated here, once" timed out after 5392ms (killed 1 dangling process)`, at ts/metalang/render.test.ts:429 (`shownBy`), result `880 pass, 1 fail`. The first run passed 881 and three later full runs passed. In those later runs the same test took 1.7-2.2s and its sibling took 1.5-2.5s, so the 5s default leaves little headroom. `shownBy` uses `Bun.spawnSync`, which blocks the event loop, and each of the two tests starts a jsdom subprocess. Neither test sets an explicit timeout.
findings.fix: Give both `shownBy` tests (render.test.ts:446 and :450) an explicit generous per-test timeout, or run the subprocess asynchronously, without weakening any assertion. Then re-run `bun test` several times and show every run exits 0.
